Nikon Preset 0.5.7-beta - Delivery and validation record
Date: 2026-10-17 (Asia/Shanghai)

FINAL ARTIFACT
File: dist/nikon-usb-0.5.7-beta-debug.apk
Application ID: com.nikonpreset.usbprobe
Version name: 0.5.7-beta
Version code: 24
APK size: 2753145 bytes
SHA-256: 491290bce7c2b81af142b03480666fdbf4b8ba5b1e4f67af6982cffe4b029a5c
Build and v2/v3 signature verification passed. Android UI checks below used
this frozen artifact. Production sources were not changed after its build.

CHANGES
- Preset and album share the existing physical Wi-Fi/PTP session in both
  directions. A completed verified import retains a fresh read owner, which
  can transfer to album and back without a new Init/Open/Close operation.
  Ownership transfer revokes old facades and preserves sockets, event reader
  and exact transaction sequence. Album remains read-only; importing again
  still needs fresh checks, immutable intent and explicit confirmation.
- Application-owned orchestration holds the connection service across the
  ownership gap, completes cancelled queued handoffs exactly once, and rejects
  stale results after disconnect. The same failed automatic preparation does
  not retry indefinitely as the UI renders; explicit retry remains possible.
- All pages use the actual live connection for status. Photo readiness is
  separate: a live but unsupported or temporarily refused album displays
  connected/photos unavailable and offers a read retry on the same session.
  Protocol loss or malformed data still terminates the invalid connection.
- Immersive remote/local viewing supports left/right navigation, accessible
  previous/next controls, correct boundaries and detail metadata pagination.
  Zoomed drag pans; multi-touch/cancel/double tap do not trigger navigation.
- Pinch follows its moving focus, lifting one finger reanchors the remaining
  pointer, and double tap animates between fit and enlargement. The touch hot
  path updates transforms/frame invalidation without decoding or rebuilding
  the stage. Same-photo preview/original upgrades preserve the viewport.
- Viewing still reads camera previews. Only explicit download reads originals;
  unknown import results still do not replay writes or silently rearm budgets.

AUTOMATED VALIDATION
22017 checks passed: core 9928 + Picture Control probe 12089.
Core includes PTP/IP 4258, album controller 319, preview cache 53 and swipe 28.
Probe breakdown: ordinary USB 685, read-only PC 453, USB copy/adaptation 1253,
wireless 9698. Synthetic peer self-tests also pass for full 49-photo album and
Picture Control on one session. See tests/PTP_CORE.md.

Independent scoped source review found no remaining P1/P2 after correcting
queued-cancellation completion and the service-start/render retry loop.
Final read-only gesture/lifecycle review likewise found no blocking P1/P2.

FINAL-APK ANDROID CHECKS
Temporary Pixel 9 / Android 17 emulator, 1080x2424; loopback-only synthetic
camera with 49 JPEG fixtures and virtual preset slots. No physical camera.
Explicit C2 import -> Album -> explicit C3 import -> Album succeeded on one
connection. All three root pages showed connected while the session lived.
Photo detail passed remote left/right, first/last boundaries, 24->48->49
pagination, double tap, zoomed pan, moving-focus pinch, remaining-finger drag,
cancel/vertical suppression, and local left/right over two downloaded images.
Before explicit downloads there were zero original requests. The only two
downloads were TEST_0049 and TEST_0048; their sizes/hashes matched fixtures.
HOME and return retained the foreground service and photos. Manual disconnect
closed the transport, updated status, stopped service and released CPU lock.
This final path issued no CloseSession; do not confuse transport close with
protocol CloseSession. The app-filtered crash buffer was empty.

matched the frozen delivery hash. No uninstall or data clear was performed.
No synthetic fixtures, phone permission changes or physical camera operations
were performed on that phone. Physical zoom feel and camera interoperability
of this build remain for user verification.

USER FEEDBACK / LIMITS
The user reports 0.5.6 import no longer closes the camera hotspot, but the
preset page showed connected while Album showed disconnected. Source review
confirmed the missing reverse handoff and inconsistent readiness checks,
which this build corrects. The earlier hotspot improvement is user feedback,
not an independently captured 0.5.7 real-camera trace.
This validation does not certify a physical frame rate, every camera/firmware,
manufacturer battery policy or indefinite background connectivity. No claim
is made that a disconnected camera hotspot can be kept alive by UI changes.
